description.en:
Reserves a pinball-style flipper on the match pitch and returns its handle. Place it with CMND_BTL_ACTIVE_FLIPPER.
Flippers are one kind of entry in the match's pitch-object table, alongside tornadoes (CMND_BTL_REG_TORNADE) and bumpers (CMND_BTL_REG_BUMPER).

Handle (index) of the reserved flipper in the pitch-object table.
null if the match system is not ready.

examples.case: Reserving the four flippers of the pinball pitch (real usage, from mf14b01.nut)
